header.name: Production Log
header.description:
**Production Log History**

This screen provides a centralized view of all production log entries, helping you track and analyze manufacturing activity over time. It is designed for operators, supervisors, and managers to monitor production performance and quality.

**Key Capabilities:**

- \*\*View Historical Records:\*\* Displays detailed logs of production runs, including timestamps, workcenter, work order, product, operator, and source.

- \*\*Performance Metrics:\*\* Shows quantities of good and scrap parts, total production, yield percentage, and cycle time for each entry.

- \*\*Filtering & Search:\*\* Use the filter panel to narrow results by date range, workcenter, work order, product, operator, schedule, or data source. Advanced GraphQL filtering is available for complex queries.

- \*\*Data Analysis Tools:\*\* Supports grouping, charting, and sorting to identify trends and improve decision-making.

- \*\*Actions:\*\* Quickly create new production entries, edit existing records, or delete logs. You can also refresh data and view detailed information for any record.

- \*\*Traceability:\*\* Each entry includes metadata such as who created it and when, ensuring full auditability.

This screen is essential for maintaining accurate production history, monitoring quality, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

props.description: Row actions menu. Click to view details, edit, or delete.

props.label: Code
props.description: Unique identifier for the production log entry. Used for traceability.

props.label: Occur At
props.description: Timestamp when production occurred. Used for time-based queries and shift assignment.

props.label: Workcenter Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique workcenter identifier.

- Often matches ERP work center code.
- Example: `WC-PRESS-01`, `WC-FILL-A`.

props.label: Work Order Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique work order number.

- Often matches ERP order number.
- Example: `WO-2025-00001`, `MO-12345`.

props.label: Product Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique product code, SKU, or part number.

- Used in work orders, labels, and integrations.
- Example: `WIDGET-001`, `ASM-12345`, `FG-SAUCE-500ML`.

props.label: Qty Good
props.description: Quantity of conforming/good parts. Contributes to OEE Quality.

props.label: Qty Scrap
props.description: Quantity of rejected/scrap parts. Includes rework and defects.

props.label: Total Qty
props.description: Total production quantity (Good + Scrap). Computed field.

props.label: Yield %
props.description: First-pass yield: (Qty Good / Total Qty) × 100. Key quality metric.

props.label: Cycle Time (s)
props.description: Actual cycle time in seconds. Used for OEE Performance.

props.label: Operator
props.description: The operator who performed this production.

props.label: Source
props.description: Origin of record: Manual, PLC, Sensor, or Integration.

props.label: Notes
props.description: Free-form notes about this production run.

props.label: Created At
props.description: System timestamp when record was created.

props.label: Created By
props.description: The email address of the User.  The email is also used as the username.
